question: Show the type of powertrain with at least two vehicles, and the average annual fuel cost for vehicles in each such type.
raw_output:
SELECT 
    t.name AS type_of_powertrain,
    AVG(r.total_hours) AS average_annual_fuel_cost
FROM 
    Vehicles v
JOIN 
    Renting_history r ON v.id = r.vehicles_id
JOIN 
    Vehicles t ON r.customer_id = t.id
JOIN 
    Discount d ON r.discount_id = d.id
GROUP BY 
    t.name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    average_annual_fuel_cost DESC;

    AVG(r.total_hours) AS average_annual_fuel_cost

JOIN 
    Vehicles t ON r.customer_id = t.id

GROUP BY 
    t.name
HAVING
